# Architecture & systems

[Wiki home](README.md) | [Edit source](../../AGENTS.md)

## Stack

- Unity 6000.6.5f1, URP (`Assets/SourceFiles/Settings/PC_RPAsset`, Forward+), Input System only, TMP (ugui 2.x)
- Netcode for GameObjects 2.13.3 + Unity Transport; Facepunch.Steamworks (`Assets/Plugins/Steamworks`, define `VOIDWARD_STEAM`, AppID 480)
- Cinemachine 3 (`Unity.Cinemachine`), Multiplayer Play Mode 3.0
- Blender 5.2 LTS (optional DCC tool, headless via CLI, no MCP). See "Blender (asset scripts)".
- Developed on two machines: Mac (macOS + WebGL build modules) and Windows PC (Windows build module). See "Cross-platform (Mac + Windows)".

## Layout (`Assets/_Project`)

- `Scripts/<Module>` with one asmdef each. Dependency order: Core ← Data ← Combat/Inventory/Planet ← Ship ← Player ← AI/World ← Progression/UI; Networking separate.
- `Editor/ContentBuilder.cs` (materials, all ScriptableObject data, balance values), `PrefabBuilder.cs` (all procedural meshes + prefabs + network prefab list), `SceneBuilder.cs` (scene `Scenes/Voidward.unity`, lighting, volume, project settings), `PlanetBuilder.cs` (planet presets `Data/Planets`, planet/ocean materials, detail textures, scene `Scenes/PlanetPreview.unity`), `BuildMenu.cs`.
- `Shaders/`: VW_ToonFlat (main lit), VW_Planet (triplanar terrain, elevation/slope/region ramp, planet-centered via `_PlanetCenter`), VW_Ocean (depth/opaque-texture water), VW_NebulaSkybox, VW_Atmosphere (depth-based ray-marched scattering shell, Cull Front + ZTest Always), VW_Clouds (procedural cloud shell), VW_Collapse, VW_Unlit, VW_AdditiveParticle, VW_Glass.
- **All content is generated.** Change the builder code, then run menu `Voidward/Build All Content`. Manual edits to generated prefabs/scene/data are overwritten.

## Architecture

- Session: `SessionManager` (host/join/transport switch, Steam → UTP fallback), `TransportConfig` (CLI: `-transport=utp|steam -autohost -autojoin=IP -autostart -players=N`).
- `DirectorSpawner` spawns the GameDirector prefab (`RunManager` + `CombatNet`) on `SessionManager.ServerStarted`.
- Journey structure (#46): `GalaxyDef` (5 assets, `ContentBuilder.BuildGalaxies`: route, distance, biome pool, enemy mix, `EnemyTier`/`LootTier`, palette, `DriveTier` for #73) -> `GalaxyGenerator.Generate(runSeed, galaxy)` = deterministic `GalaxyPlan` with 4-6 `StarSystem`s (`SystemKind`: Planetary, AsteroidField, Anomaly, Enclave (exactly one, Warden + hoard), Nomads (trader station), Void; system 0 = arrival, galaxy 1 system 0 = "Wormhole Exit" with station). `SystemLayout.Build(seed, galaxy, kind, station)` = the system corridor (planets, fields, wrecks, boss pos). Clients regenerate everything from the synced `RunSeed`/`GalaxyIndex`/`SystemIndex` (`RunManager.Plan`, `CurrentSystem`).
- `RunManager`: run lifecycle (start / continue / end), galaxy+system flow, warp (no button since #108: `ServerJump(target, lead)` from a jump zone, `ServerWarp(target)` for cheats/dev; `WarpNextGalaxy` = -1 one-way, from galaxy 5 = the flight home (#81); `ServerGoto(g, s)` for dev), ships/players, respawns, run clock (`RunTime`), stats, cheats (`ExecuteCheat(int)`). `SystemDirector` (plain server class): system content (`PopulatePlanet` POIs, wrecks, station), enemy spawning, events, Warden enclave. Revisited systems keep worlds/nodes/nests but spawn no crates (`VisitedMask`). Suspend save: `RunState` (versioned JSON, players by name, ships with modules/cargo) via `RunSave` (one slot `vw_run.json`), written on galaxy entry and `SessionManager.BeforeLeave` (host leaves/quits, also when stopping Play Mode), deleted by `EndRun`; lobby "Continue Run" -> `SessionManager.ContinueRun`. UI: `GalaxyMapView` (key M, `VwInput.Map`), HUD system meter + run clock.
- Warp drive (#78): `WarpDrive` (World, on the GameDirector; since #49 the Nostos's drive: worked on aboard it, `AtShip`): `Tiers` (NetworkList, tier per `DriveSlot` Core/Navigation/Cooling/Tank, 1-6) + `Exotic` (tank). Parts are items (`ItemKind.DriveComponent`, `ItemDef.Drive` -> `DriveComponentDef`, ids `drive_<core|nav|cooling|tank>_mk<1-6>`), swapped/loaded via `InstallFromInventoryServerRpc` / `LoadExoticServerRpc` near a ship. Balance in `WarpDriveDef` (core speeds, tank sizes, nav/cooling penalties) + `GalaxyDef.LegLength` (minutes with a balanced Mk I) / `LegFuel`; `DriveMath` = pure ETA/fuel math (`Minutes`, `Fuel`, `Eta`, `Delta`; stop `DriveMath.Home` = 6). Galaxy warps (`WarpNextGalaxy`, `WarpSkipGalaxy` = -2) check and burn Exotic Matter in `RunManager.FuelOk/ServerWarp`. UI: inventory tab *Warp Drive* (`EventBus.RaiseDrivePanelRequested`), galaxy map ETA/fuel/skip, HUD ETA line, cockpit via `GameState.HomeEta`. Save `RunState` v2 (`DriveTiers`, `Exotic`; v1 loads as Mk I).
- Flown galaxy warp (#79): `WarpFlight` (World, on the GameDirector): `RunManager.ServerWarp` to a galaxy stop -> `BeginWarpFlight` (director cleared) -> `WarpFlight.ServerBegin(from, to, lead)` -> ... -> `ServerArrive` -> `RunManager.ServerArrive(stop)` (`WarpTo` or the homecoming). Floating origin: ships stay near x = 0 (`WarpBubble.Axis` = +X), the corridor streams past; route length = model minutes / build factor / `BalancedFactor` x full-throttle speed (`VisualSpeed` per core tier), so a flight at the nav's safe speed in fields and full speed elsewhere takes `DriveMath.Minutes`. `WarpRoute` (pure, deterministic per flight seed, obstacles generated per 1 km chunk, id = chunk * 1024 + i): legs, zones (`WarpZone` ExitHalo/Void/ArrivalHalo, 12 % halos per leg), `WarpHazard` (Rock, Debris, Comet, GravityWell, StrayRock), 3 `WarpSignal`s per leg, `PatrolIn(chunk)`. Server state as NetworkVariables (Progress, Throttle, Heat, Cruise, Stalled, Overheated, Lead, Hazard, DroppedOut, DropSignal, ResumeCountdown, VisitedSignals, `Destroyed` list); fuel burns along the route (a mid-flight suspend save refunds it, the crew continues before the warp). `WarpBubble` (Core, static) carries the local state to Ship/Player: `ShipFlight.WarpStep` (lead: nose/strafe -> lateral velocity, cone 35 deg, corridor walls, `WarpBubble.Pull`; others: formation slot `WarpBubble.FormationOffset`), `ShipSeat.TickPilot` feeds W/S, X, C, G (`VwInput.Cruise/DropOut`), `PlayerPawn` FOV boost. `WarpCorridorView` (client, every peer): obstacle GameObjects inside the scanner range (`ScanRange` = nav fraction x speed x 2.6 s), `WarpObstacleProxy` trigger colliders for shots (like `AsteroidRock`), impact detection for every ship the peer simulates (`ShipFlight.IsSimulating`) -> `ReportImpactServerRpc`, gravity well pull, signal beacon, gas cloud, speed streaks. Sky: `SystemVisuals` swings the destination galaxy ahead and grows it with the progress. Signal sites spawn through `SystemDirector` (`SpawnWreckSite`, `SpawnRoguePlanet`, `TrackedCount`/`TakeTracked`). HUD: route meter + zone, throttle/heat/ETA/Exotic/cruise/signal line, centre warnings, ship card speed = warp throttle.
- Flight home (#81, the Rift was removed in #145): the galaxy warp 5 -> `DriveMath.Home` (`WarpFlight.IsFinale`, ~5 min with the Home Drive, LMC `LegLength` 1200 / speed 240). `FinaleStart` (NetworkVariable, route m) = `FinaleSeconds` (300 s) of planned flight before the end, walked back over the real zones (`FinaleStartOf`; 0 with the Home Drive, the last ~5 min with weaker drives); `WarpRoute(finaleStart)` makes that stretch the densest of the game (void: more stray rocks, wells, comets), drops signals in/near it and the arrival welcome party. No chaser. Arrival -> `ServerArrive(Home)` -> `RunManager.ServerHomecoming` -> homecoming result (placeholder for the Sol approach, #74).
- System cruise + hops (#80): `ShipFlight` cruise (authority of a piloted ship): hold C (`ShipSeat` -> `SetCruiseInput`) for `CruiseSpool` 2 s, then `DriveMath.CruiseSpeed` per core tier (`WarpDriveDef.CruiseSpeed` 1-3 km/s, `WarpBubble.CoreTier` written by `WarpDrive`), owner-written `CruiseNet` (`CruiseMode`). Ends: X/S/C, a hull hit (`OnHullHit` = interdiction, blocks 3 s), engaged enemies within `CombatLockRange` (`Threat.EngagedNear`), a sphere cast ahead (collision alert), and towards a planet the closing speed eases down to normal flight at `GravitySource.CruiseRadius` (gravity field, at least radius + 1 km; `CruiseClearance`). Gravity + combat lock also hold jump zones (`RunManager.JumpBlockFor`). System warps are flown hops: `WarpFlight.ServerBeginHop` (`TargetSystem` >= 0, `IsHop`), `WarpRoute(hop: true)` = one leg, 20 % system outskirts at each end with 40 % rock density, no signals/welcome party, `ZoneName`; length from `DriveMath.HopMinutes` (`WarpDriveDef.HopMinutes` 1.5 x factor / speed^0.35), no Exotic Matter; arrival `RunManager.ServerArriveSystem` -> system edge. Interdiction in any warp: engaged enemies within `WarpFlight.InterdictRange` of the lead ship or enemy hits on its hull stop the bubble (`[Warp] interdicted`). Normal flight: module thrust/top speed capped at `ShipCore.NormalFlightCap` (+30 %).
- Jump zones (#108): no warp button or countdown. `SystemLayout.AddJumpZones(plan, system)` (also in `GalaxyGenerator.Layout` and `SystemDirector.Enter`) puts `JumpZone`s (Core, `JumpZones` static: `Current`, `Blocks`, `CrewMissing`, `Entering`, `Veil`) on an ellipsoid around the corridor, pushed out until clear of every planet's gravity field: a hop zone to each neighbouring system (`GalaxyPlan` order, aimed like the map), and in the outermost system the Galactic Rim (`WarpNextGalaxy`, normal = `SystemVisuals.DestinationDir`; LMC: `JumpKind.Home` towards `MilkyWayDir`) plus the skip zone (`WarpSkipGalaxy`, beside it, further out). `WarpFlight.Jumps.cs` (partial): server packs a `JumpBlock` per zone into `JumpBlocks` (crew not aboard = a living pawn neither seated nor inside a `GravityVolume`; Exotic Matter/tank; combat/gravity lock via `RunManager.JumpBlockFor`); a piloted ship inside an open zone that crosses its plane cruising, or after `JumpZones.AlignSeconds` (3 s) nose outward, starts the entry (`EntryAt` = server time + `EnterSeconds` 2.6 s: FOV, entry speed lines in `WarpCorridorView`, veil) -> `RunManager.ServerJump` -> `BeginWarpFlight(seamless)` -> `WarpFlight.ServerRebaseIntoBubble` (every ship keeps its offset/attitude to the lead turned so the lead's nose = `WarpBubble.Axis`; ships > 450 m away get a formation slot; the bubble starts in warp cruise at ~nav/sustain x 0.8). End of the route: `ServerBeginExit` holds the flight `ExitSeconds` 0.8 s while the veil rises, then `RunManager.ServerArrive(System)(.., lead)` -> `RegroupOutOfWarp` (rigid transform to `SystemLayout.Arrival(fromSystem)`: inside the zone leading back, nose inward; galaxies: `StartPoint`) + `ShipFlight.ArriveFromWarpRpc` (owner, applied once the bubble state ended: piloted ships cruise in). The veil (`RebaseAt`, `VeilAt` curve, colour by `VeilKind`) is a full-screen image in `UIRoot`. Blocked zones: `ShipFlight.JumpZoneHold` (owner) dumps cruise and holds the ship at the plane. Visuals: `SystemVisuals.BuildJumpZones` (turning beacon ring + motes, additive dots, colour per `JumpKind`); HUD: zone markers with block reason, centre `JumpMessage` (ALIGNING n% / JUMP ZONE HOLDS - reason / WARP ENTRY); galaxy map = navigation only (hop lanes, zone list, galaxy warp ETA/fuel).
- Journey end and failing (#145, the time loop of #86 and the Rift were removed): `RunManager.ServerHomecoming` is the only end of a run (`GamePhase.DemoComplete`, results screen = the homecoming screen, `RunSave.Delete`); there is no `GameOver`, no `Loop`, no `NewLoop`, no cryo charges (`RespawnsLeft` gone). A fallen pawn wakes in its Nostos cryo pod after `RespawnAt` (`TryRespawnPoint`; falls back to its ship while the Nostos is disabled). The Nostos at 0 hull is not destroyed: `ShipCore.OnDied` sets `Derelict` (disabled: no warp lead/jump zones, no workbench, no cryo, `ShipDerelictLook`), `ShipCore.ClaimServerRpc` repairs it for `HomeRepairSalvage` (120, terminal/seat prompt = `RestorePrompt`), `RunManager.OnShipDestroyed` logs and saves; the save keeps its `Derelict`/hull. The journey is also saved when a ship docks at the Nostos (`ShipCore.ServerDocked` -> `RunManager.OnShipDocked`, at most every 30 s), on every galaxy arrival and when the host leaves. Texts: `StoryDef` now only holds the logbook templates ({galaxy}/{eta}/{part}/{ship}); `RunManager.ServerLog` -> `EventBus.LogbookEntry` (HUD ticker in `RadioView`, which replaced `LoopView`: radio captions + ticker) + `RunSummary.Log`. The story intro plays once per player (`Meta.IntroSeen`, old saves with runs count as seen). Lobby: *Start Mission* / *New Journey* (save exists) / *Continue Journey*. Down/revive and the failed landing (#146): at 0 health a pawn is *down* (`PlayerPawn.IsDown`, `BleedLeft` = `BleedSeconds` 45 s, body lies down, the owner's view drops): a crewmate within `ReviveRange` 3 m holds [F] for `ReviveSeconds` 4 s (owner heartbeat `ReviveHoldServerRpc` every 0.12 s -> `ServerReviveHold`, the bleed pauses while held, progress decays at half speed otherwise, `ReviveFrac` for the HUD) and the pawn comes back where it fell with 40 % health (`ServerRevive`); bled out (`BleedLeft` 0) = `RunManager` wakes it in its cryo pod after `CryoWakeDelay` 4 s (`RespawnAt`). A bleeding crewmate outside still counts as missing for jump zones. Landing party (`RunManager.TickLanding`): living pawns that are neither seated nor inside a `GravityVolume`, not downed in a cockpit (`ServerDownedSeated`); when all of them are down -> `ServerFailLanding`: backpack items lost (Salvage and worn gear stay), bleeding ends at once, a party member's ship within 400 m of a planet surface and not docked becomes a wreck (`Derelict`, `OwnerPlayer` = `NoPlayer`, cargo stays, ping + logbook), the owner gets a replacement Dart after 20 s; wrecks are despawned when the crew leaves the system (`WarpTo`; the persistent world state is #142; wrecks are not saved). `IsLost` and the Collapse damage kill are gone.
- Home ship Nostos (#49): `ShipClass.HomeShip` (`ShipCore.IsHome`, `ShipCore.Home`), prefab `Ship_Nostos` from `NostosBuilder` (partial `ContentBuilder`; hull = the Ark asset at 1.5 x by `Tools/Blender/nostos.py`, which also ingests/builds `Nostos_Hall` (corridor kit, one wall mirrored, doors removed, airlock cut) and `Nostos_CryoPod`; `GltfModelSource` imports them with their glTF texture folders). Rooms stern to bow: engine room (warp core + `ShipTerminal.Mode.WarpDrive`, engineer, aft turret), cargo hall (the kit at `NHallZ`, airlock + ramp, fabricator, cargo, `DockHatch`es), cryo bay (`CryoPod` x4), bridge (platform + ramp, Dart fittings, forward turret). The `N*` constants in `NostosBuilder` must match `nostos.py` ROOMS/DOOR/HALL_Z. `RunManager`: the run (and the suspend save, `ShipSave` of class HomeShip) spawns the Nostos first (`SpawnHomeShip`), each player's Dart docks at clamp = player slot, players start seated in it; destroyed = `EndRun` ("Nostos destroyed", `StoryDef.ResetHomeLost/LogHomeLost`); fallen players wake at their `CryoPod` (`TryRespawnPoint`, `ShipCore.ServerCryoWake`), `RespawnsLeft` = cryo charges (HUD "CRYO"); replacement Darts wait at a free clamp. Docking: `ShipCore.DockedTo`/`DockIndex` (server-written), `ServerDock/ServerUndock`, `RequestDockServerRpc` (authority of a piloted ship within `DockClamp.CaptureRange` 16 m / `CaptureSpeed` 14 m/s of a free clamp, `ShipFlight.TryDock`), `RequestUndockServerRpc` (pilot holds W/up 0.6 s, not in warp) -> `ShipFlight.LaunchFromDockRpc`; a docked ship has its colliders off, its authority pins it to the clamp (`DockStep`) and every peer snaps it in `LateUpdate` (`ShipFlight` runs at execution order -60, before the seated pawns); `ShipSeat.ExitPoint` of a docked ship = the clamp's hatch inside. Warps: `WarpFlight.PickLead` = the Nostos while it exists, only its pilot opens jump zones, `ServerDockForWarp` docks every free small ship under the veil (`PlayerClamp`), docked ships are skipped by formation/regroup/impact code. Heavy landing (`ShipDef.HeavyLanding`, `MaxLandingSlope` 14 deg, `MaxDescentSpeed` 6 m/s): `ShipFlight.HeavyLanding` caps the descent within 120 m and hovers at 10 m over steeper ground (3-point `GroundSlope`). `ShipDef.Hardpoints` (`ShipHardpoint`: name, `ModuleSlot`, position, normal) = data for #50.
- Crew body (#95): the CoP spacesuit (`Art/Models/Crew/Crew_Suit.fbx`, own UE4-style skeleton, Humanoid) animated by the Quaternius UAL (`Art/Animations/UAL/UAL_Standard.fbx`, CC0, Humanoid, retargeted); `CrewBuilder` (partial `ContentBuilder`) builds the importers, the used clips, `Crew_Locomotion.controller` (Speed signed fwd m/s, Mode 0 ground / 1 air / 2 EVA, Fire trigger; arms layer with mask for held tools) and `Crew_Seated.controller` (sitting loop, IK pass); without the suit FBX the UAL mannequin is the body, without UAL the procedural astronaut. On foot: `CrewAnimator` (Player, every peer, no NetworkAnimator): speed from the pawn's interpolated motion, mode/tool/use from the owner-written `PlayerPawn.Pose` byte (`PackPose`/`UnpackPose`), strafe/backwards = body yaw +-70 deg + reversed locomotion, held tool = a copy of the tool model under the right hand (`HandGrip` from the bind pose). Seated: `CrewSeatPose` (Ship) on `ShipSeat.seatedBody`: eyes aligned to the seat's ViewPoint once per sit-down, wrist IK + finger curl on optional grips (Dart: `Interior/Stick|Throttle/GripIK`, `SeatGrips`), shown for the local pilot too with the head bone collapsed. Crew colour (#60) = the visor rim (`CrewLights.colorProperty` `_RimColor`). Tools (`GearModelBuilder`): `Art/Models/Tools/Tool_<Drill|Blaster|Rifle>.fbx` from `Tools/Blender/crew_assets.py` (barrel +Z, origin = palm on the grip), materials by importer remap (`RemapMaterials`), first-person viewmodels at real size with `PlayerPawn.toolMuzzles` (`ToolMuzzle`), icons rendered from the models; the medkit stays procedural.
- `GameState` (Core/Contracts.cs): static shared client state (UIOpen, Phase, SectorIndex, Objective…).
- Authority: pawns + ships use owner-authoritative NetworkTransform; pilot seat transfers ship ownership. Projectiles are server-simulated in `CombatNet` with cosmetic client copies. Planets/asteroids are seed-synced, not replicated.
- Planets (#17, #21): radius 1.0-1.9 km (`SystemLayout.Min/MaxPlanetRadius`, 0-3 per system depending on its kind, alternating corridor sides). `BiomeDef.Shape` -> `PlanetShapeDef` (noise layers, landforms = volcano/mesa/spire/basin/dome, canyon network incl. river/lava channels, craters, ocean, region colors, sites, atmosphere, clouds, decor style, particles, weather). `PlanetTerrain` = deterministic, thread-safe height field (single source of truth for chunks, colliders, decor, sites, `PlanetBody` queries, `Raycast`). `PlanetVisuals` = 6 quadtrees of chunks (`PlanetMesh.BuildChunk` on worker threads, tangent-adjusted cube mapping, skirts, horizon culling), collider tiles streamed around `TerrainAnchor`s (pawn + ship prefabs), per-chunk props (`PlanetDecor`), set pieces (`PlanetLandmarks`), ocean/atmosphere/cloud shells. `PlanetAmbience` (client) = particles, weather, haze/ambient override, wind audio. `PlanetBody.SiteKinds` (deterministic) drive POI clusters in `SystemDirector.PopulatePlanet` and HUD site markers. `GravitySource.GroundRadiusAt` makes altitude checks terrain-aware. Far terrain has no colliders: use `PlanetBody.Raycast/SurfaceWorldPoint` or `GravitySource.GroundPoint`, not Physics, for spawn/placement. Dev preview: menu `Voidward/Open Planet Preview`, then Play. Planet look (#70): VW_Planet = soft wrap lighting (no toon bands), procedural macro noise (never fades), cavity AO from chunk UV1.x (mesh Laplacian), cliff strata; VW_Ocean = depth absorption, reflects the planet's own sky (`_SkyColor`/`_HorizonColor`), distance-dependent GGX glint, shore foam, `PlanetShapeDef.Lava` switches to the crust/crack lava mode; VW_Clouds = soft edges + sun-offset self shadow. Planets 3.0 (#115): `PlanetTerrain` erosion (`PlanetShapeDef.ErosionDepth/Scale/Octaves/Slope/Branching`, preset helper `PlanetBuilder.Erosion`) = downhill branching gullies from jittered 3D plane-wave cells, steered by a slope grid precomputed once per planet (parallel, ~0.3 x gully wavelength on the cube faces); `ElevationFrac(d, minWavelength)` band-limits noise octaves + erosion (chunks pass 2.2 x vertex spacing; gameplay queries use full detail; skirts reach `ErosionDepthMeters` deeper). Own RNG, so craters/landforms/sites of a seed did not move. Decor: `Prop.Outcrop` (big rocks half buried in slopes steeper than `MinSlope`, aligned to the hillside); far decor (`PlanetDecor.GenerateFar`, procedural, no colliders, 60 % / 30 % density) on the two LOD levels above the large-decor level, shown only while that node itself is drawn (`Node.FarDecor`). `LodQuality` default 2, `_LayerFade` 300. Water: `VW_Ocean` screen-space reflections (`_SSR`, LOD-0 samples), `ShoreFoam` (1 surf, ~0.3 calm lakes); `VW_Planet` wet shore band via `_SeaRadius`/`_WetBand`. Provinces (#115): `PlanetShapeDef.Provinces` (`ProvinceDef`: Kind Plains/Hills/Mountains/Plateau/Basin, Share, Elevation, Relief, Frequency, Sharpness, Terraces, EdgeCliff, Erosion, Region; preset helpers `PlanetBuilder.Prov/Provinces`) replace most global noise layers: `ProvinceCount` jittered Fibonacci cells (own RNG, kinds by quota so every seed shows the mix, per-cell height `Lift`), soft Voronoi over a two-octave warped direction (`ProvinceBlend`, `ProvinceWarp`); cliff provinces sharpen their elevation step (strength varies along the edge), erosion and the colour zone (`RegionAt`) follow the provinces. Far decor skips rocks (they read as dark specks); `PlanetVisuals.FarDecor` = dev switch. PBR surface layers (#100): `PlanetShapeDef.Ground/Cliff/Region/Low/PeakLayer` (`SurfaceLayer`: albedo, OpenGL normal, ARM mask, scale m, tint, normal, contrast, mean colour filled by the builder) from `Art/Terrain/<Set>/` (CC0 Poly Haven/ambientCG, converted by `Tools/Blender/planet_assets.py --ingest`), assigned per preset in `PlanetBuilder.AssignSurfaceLayers`; `PlanetVisuals.ApplySurfaceLayers` enables `_SURFACE_LAYERS` on VW_Planet: nested weights (region, low = below sea + `ShoreBand`, peak above `PeakStart`, cliff on top), triplanar with explicit gradients (weak layers/projections are skipped), the ramp tints the set by luminance (ramp colour x texture brightness / set mean), ARM roughness drives the highlight; it fades back to the procedural look at `_LayerFade` x ground scale, so orbit views are unchanged. No ground layer = the old procedural look. Asset props (#100): `Tools/Blender/planet_assets.py` (build) exports `Art/Models/Planet/Planet_<Rock|MossRock|Crystal|Ice|AlienTree|FistPlant|MinePlant|AlienPlant|Mushroom>*.fbx` (rocks: centre origin, radius 1; others: bottom origin, height 1; 0.9-4.5k tris), `PlanetModelBuilder` imports them CPU-readable with the source folder's materials -> `ContentCatalog.PlanetProps`. `PlanetPropLibrary` (Planet) copies them into arrays once; families by id prefix ("Pod" = the small alien plants). `PlanetDecor.AssetFamily` maps procedural props to families (rocks/pebbles/boulders -> Rock, jungle -> MossRock, desert -> DesertRock; ice shard/spike -> Ice; crystal/spire -> Crystal; pod, tree, mushroom; shrub -> SpruceBush, conifer -> Spruce, cactus -> Saguaro, dry bush -> Rooibos, fern -> Fern, dead tree -> DeadTree, basalt -> Basalt (`StackBasalt`), hoodoo -> stacked DesertRock), the variant comes from the prop's own seed (placement unchanged); worker threads bake them into a `PropBatch` per chunk -> `DecorProps` child (submesh per model material; `PlanetVisuals.PropMaterial` tints rock/crystal/ice by `DecorColors`). Still procedural: vent, ember rock (they glow). Foliage cards get bent normals in the build (`FOLIAGE` material keywords), else back-lit cards turn black. Landmarks: frozen spires, elder tree, giant fungi, crystal colossus, floating isles, boulder field, hoodoos, basalt organ use the assets (glow bits stay procedural). `Generated` textures (MetallicSmoothness packs) are imported at once even inside BuildAll's asset editing block (`assetBatching`), so a new asset needs one build, not two. Asteroids (`SystemVisuals` fields, `WarpCorridorView` rocks) use the Rock family: one submesh per variant, convex MeshCollider on the scan scaled by the radius, fragments = the scan.
- Seats don't reparent: the pawn follows `ShipSeat.SeatOf` in LateUpdate; seated capsules are disabled on all peers.
- Light, sky, VFX (#96): `VW_NebulaSkybox` = NASA SVS star map cubemap (`Art/Sky/Starmap_8k.jpg`, 2048 faces, keyword `_STARMAP`, rotated per galaxy by `SystemVisuals.StarMapRotation`, `PaletteDef.StarField`/`NebulaField`) + domain-warped nebula. Reflections: `SystemVisuals` renders one sky-only realtime `SkyProbe` per system; reflection cameras get the global `_VWReflectionPass` = 1, so the sky adds a soft fill there (PBR metal reflects shape, not black). Realtime probes must stay on in QualitySettings (`SceneBuilder.EnableRealtimeProbes`). Post: ACES, HDR grading, SMAA High, 4K main-light shadows; per-galaxy grade in `PaletteDef`. VFX: `VW_FlipbookParticle` (premultiplied, `_Additive`, frame blending, soft particles); `VfxManager` textured layers (Unity Labs flipbooks, Kenney sprites) from `SkyVfxBuilder`, sources converted by `Tools/Blender/space_textures.py`; missing textures fall back to the procedural look. Projectiles (`CombatNet.DressVisual`): camera-facing head glow/flare (`VW_GlowSprite`, child quad of the pooled bolt, colour by property block), short textured energy trail for bolts/orbs, smoke trail for missiles (catalog `Fx*Material`). Engines: `VW_Plume` shock diamonds + turbulent flicker, `NozzleGlow` sprite per thruster (`PrefabBuilder.Thrusters`). Warp speed lines, comet tails and the warp speed streaks use the Kenney streak (`FxStreakMaterial`). Journey sky: `GalaxyDef.NextGalaxyImage` (M31 GALEX, NGC 6822 ESO, Leo I generated, LMC ESO) and `ContentCatalog.MilkyWayImage` (NASA/JPL artist concept), converted by `Tools/Blender/galaxy_textures.py`; `SystemVisuals.SkyImage` = camera-facing quad with a fixed roll (`VW_SkyImage`, unfogged `_FogAmount` 0), the dot spirals stay as the fallback.
- Floating origin: each system is generated around the origin; on warp, ships and pawns are rebased via `NetTeleport` (sent to the transform owner). `SystemVisuals` (client) builds asteroids, galaxy palette, music and the journey sky (destination galaxy + Milky Way growing per galaxy).
- UI is fully code-built (`UIKit`, `UIRoot`, `MenuScreens`, `HudView`, `InventoryView`, `TradeView`). Namespace `Voidward.UI` has enum `Screen` → write `UnityEngine.Screen` explicitly.
- Meta progression (to be redefined in #47 without runs/loops): `Progression/Meta.cs` (Memory fragments = `Memories`, perks, local save; `Meta.ResetAll()`; saves from before #112 are migrated by a raw-JSON rename in `SaveSystem.Load(key, migrate)`, run save v4 likewise for Credits -> `Salvage`).
